name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US strikes S. Iran 15 Nov; 3rd carrier arrives
summary: US struck Iranian missile launchers on 15 Nov after Iranian drone and missile attacks; third US carrier arrives
state: US forces struck Iranian missile launchers near Bandar Lengeh and Sirik on the night of 15 Nov, after Iran fired drones at Bahrain's Riffa air base and missiles at tankers; CENTCOM said US assets were not damaged (Euronews, 16 Nov). The USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the region on 15 Nov, joining two other carrier groups, and an Iranian deputy foreign minister said Iran would not wait to be attacked first (Al Jazeera). Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Bahrain and the wider Gulf should follow FCDO travel advice, which can change at short notice. Expect knock-on effects on energy prices and flights.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states (US–Iran, 15 Nov) = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
